Select: molecule_chembl_id, molecule_name, max_phase, molecule_type, canonical_smiles. Source: molecule_dictionary, compound_structures, docs. Join: molecule_dictionary via molregno to compound_records on molregno; compound_records via doc_id to docs on doc_id; molecule_dictionary via molregno to compound_structures on molregno. Filter: docs.chembl_id equals 'CHEMBL1150404'. Sort: molecule_chembl_id ascending.
